data.value: select ROW_NUMBER () OVER(ORDER BY Gate_outwardheader.Gate_OutwardHeaderID DESC) AS Row, Gate_outwardheader.DocumentTypeID, set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Gate_outwardheader.DocumentNo, Gate_outwardheader.DocumentDate, INV_Item.Description AS Item, set_location.locationname AS Location, Case When Gate_outwardheader.SupplierID is null then Gate_outwardheader.SupplierName else AR_Set_customer.CustomerName end AS Supplier, INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit as Unit, Gate_outwardheader.VehicalNo, Gate_outwarddetail.TransactionQuantity as Quantity, Gate_outwarddetail.Reason, (INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit * Gate_outwarddetail.TransactionQuantity) As Amount, INV_ITEM.InventoryItemStatusCode AS PartNo, IncRude_Item.Description as IncurredOn, Gate_outwardheader.Comments as Remarks, Gate_outwarddetail.ReferenceNo as Reference, case when set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Negative' then 'OUT' when set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Positive' then 'IN' when set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='No Impact' then '' else set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact end Status, SET_OperatingUnit.LogoImage ,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName , Case Gate_outwardheader.StatusCode When 1 then 'Approved' When 5 then 'In Process' When 12 Then 'Released for Approve' When 13 Then 'Partially Approved' When 14 Then 'Discuss' When 15 Then 'Cancelled' When 16 Then 'Reversed' End As DocumentStatus from Gate_outwardheader inner join set_DocumentType on set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Gate_outwardheader.DocumentTypeID and set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Gate_outwardheader.CompanyID and set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Gate_outwardheader.PeriodID inner join Gate_outwarddetail on Gate_outwarddetail.Gate_OutwardHeaderID = Gate_outwardheader.Gate_OutwardHeaderID and Gate_outwarddetail.companyID = Gate_outwardheader.companyID and Gate_outwarddetail.PeriodID = Gate_outwardheader.PeriodID inner join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = Gate_outwarddetail.itemID --and INV_Item.companyID = Gate_outwardheader.companyID inner join set_location on set_location.locationID = Gate_outwardheader.locationID Left join AR_Set_customer on AR_Set_customer.CustomerID = Gate_outwardheader.SupplierID --and AR_Set_customer.companyID = Gate_outwardheader.companyID and AR_Set_customer.PeriodID = Gate_outwardheader.PeriodID left join inv_StockTransactionDetail on inv_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = Gate_outwarddetail.SourceHeaderID and inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = Gate_outwarddetail.SourceLineID left join INV_Item IncRude_Item on IncRude_Item.ItemID = Gate_OutwardHeader.IncurredOnID --and IncRude_Item.companyID = Gate_outwardheader.companyID Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = Gate_outwardheader.CompanyID Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Left JOIn SET_UnitofMeasure On SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = Gate_outwarddetail.TransactionUOMID --inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = Gate_OutwardHeader.DocumentNo --AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = Gate_OutwardHeader.DocumentTypeID --AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = Gate_OutwardHeader.CompanyID --and INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID = Gate_OutwardHeader.SupplierID --AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = Gate_OutwardHeader.PeriodID --AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 where Gate_outwardheader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and Gate_outwardheader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND Gate_outwardheader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID {0}

data.name: Query_GetDataforDetailByGONNO
data.value:
Select distinct 0 as SerialNo, 0 as Gate_OutwardDetailID ,0 as Gate_OutwardHeaderID ,Gate_OutwardDetail.ItemID ,Gate_OutwardDetail.TransactionUOMID
,isnull((Gate_OutwardDetail.TransactionQuantity - isnull(Tab.TransactionQuantity,0) ),0) as TransactionQuantity
,Gate_OutwardHeader.Gate_OutwardHeaderID as SourceHeaderID,Gate_OutwardDetail.Gate_OutwardDetailID as SourceLineID ,Gate_OutwardHeader.DocumentTypeID as SourceDocumentTypeID ,Gate_OutwardDetail.SourceDocumentNo,Gate_OutwardDetail.ReferenceNo ,INV_Item.Description ,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit ,Gate_OutwardDetail.CompanyID , Gate_OutwardDetail.PeriodID ,'Add' as Action from Gate_OutwardDetail Inner Join Gate_OutwardHeader on Gate_OutwardHeader.Gate_OutwardHeaderID = Gate_OutwardDetail.Gate_OutwardHeaderID Left Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = Gate_OutwardDetail.ItemID Left Join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = Gate_OutwardDetail.TransactionUOMID Left Join ( Select Sum(Gate_OutwardDetail.TransactionQuantity) as TransactionQuantity ,Gate_OutwardDetail.SourceHeaderID -- ,Gate_OutwardDetail.Gate_OutwardDetailID ,Gate_OutwardDetail.SourceLineID from Gate_OutwardDetail Inner Join Gate_OutwardHeader on Gate_OutwardHeader.Gate_OutwardHeaderID = Gate_OutwardDetail.Gate_OutwardHeaderID Where Gate_OutwardDetail.Status =1 And Gate_OutwardDetail.SourceHeaderID = @DocumentNo
Group by Gate_OutwardDetail.SourceLineID, Gate_OutwardDetail.SourceHeaderID ) as Tab on Tab.SourceHeaderID = Gate_OutwardDetail.Gate_OutwardHeaderID And Gate_OutwardDetail.Gate_OutwardDetailID = Tab.SourceLineID Where Gate_OutwardHeader.Gate_OutwardHeaderID = @DocumentNo And isnull((Gate_OutwardDetail.TransactionQuantity - isnull(Tab.TransactionQuantity,0) ),0) <> 0 And Gate_OutwardHeader.Status =1 And Gate_OutwardDetail.Status =1 And Gate_OutwardDetail.Status =1
Order By Gate_OutwardDetail.Gate_OutwardDetailID

data.name: Query_GetDataForItemIssuanceGatePassReport
data.value:
Select DocumentNo, ItemCode , ItemID ,Description ,DocumentDate ,ABS(SUM(IssuanceQty)) as IssuanceQty ,ABS(Sum(ReturnQty)) as ReturnQty ,UOMname,CostCenterName,Comments from ( Select INV_StockTransactionHEader.DocumentNo, INV_ITEm.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemCode,INV_ITem.ItemID,INV_ITem.Description,INV_StockTransactionHEader.DocumentDate ,SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) as IssuanceQty, 0 as ReturnQty ,Set_unitOFMeasure.UOMname,Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName,INV_StockTransactionHEader.Comments from INV_StockTransactionHEader inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHEader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHEader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHEader.PeriodID
inner join INV_ITEM on INV_ITEM.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_ITEM.CompanyID
left join Set_unitOFMeasure on Set_unitOFMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID left join Set_costCenter on Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionHEader.CostCenterID
where INV_StockTransactionHEader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionHEader.periodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionHEader.Status = 1 And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 And INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID =(Select DocumentTypeID from Set_DocumentType Where DocumentType ='OpenReturnableGON')
{0}
group by INV_StockTransactionHEader.DocumentNo,INV_ITEm.InventoryItemStatusCode,INV_ITem.Description,INV_ITem.ItemID, INV_StockTransactionHEader.DocumentDate,Set_unitOFMeasure.UOMname,Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName,INV_StockTransactionHEader.Comments
Union All
Select INV_StockTransactionHEader.DocumentNo, INV_ITEm.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemCode,INV_ITem.ItemID,INV_ITem.Description,INV_StockTransactionHEader.DocumentDate , 0 as IssuanceQty,SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) as ReturnQty ,Set_unitOFMeasure.UOMname,Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName,INV_StockTransactionHEader.Comments from INV_StockTransactionHEader inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHEader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHEader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHEader.PeriodID inner join INV_ITEM on INV_ITEM.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_ITEM.CompanyID
left join Set_unitOFMeasure on Set_unitOFMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID left join Set_costCenter on Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionHEader.CostCenterID
where INV_StockTransactionHEader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionHEader.periodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionHEader.Status = 1 And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 And INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID =(Select DocumentTypeID from Set_DocumentType Where DocumentType ='OpenReturnableGIN')
{0}
group by INV_StockTransactionHEader.DocumentNo,INV_ITEm.InventoryItemStatusCode,INV_ITem.Description,INV_ITem.ItemID, INV_StockTransactionHEader.DocumentDate,Set_unitOFMeasure.UOMname,Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName,INV_StockTransactionHEader.Comments
) as Tab
Group By ItemID, DocumentNo, ItemCode ,Description ,DocumentDate ,UOMname,CostCenterName,Comments
order by Tab.DocumentDate asc

Select ROW_NUMBER () OVER(ORDER BY SAL_GateIn.GateInID DESC) AS Row, SAL_GateIn.DocumentTypeID,set_DocumentType.DocumentType, SAL_GateIn.GateInNo as DocumentNo, SAL_GateIn.GateInDate as DocumentDate, SAL_GateIn.ItemName as Item, SAL_GateIn.CustomerName as Supplier, SAL_GateIn.Quantity , SAL_GateIn.RRNo as Reference, SAL_GateIn.VehicleNo , SAL_GateIn.CNICNO as CNIC , SAL_GateIn.DriverMobileNo as DrMobileNO, SAL_GateIn.DriverName, SAL_GateIn.LICNo, case when set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Negative' then 'OUT' when set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Positive' then 'IN' when set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='No Impact' then '' else set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact end Status, SET_OperatingUnit.LogoImage ,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,
Case SAL_GateIn.StatusCode When 1 then 'Approved' When 5 then 'In Process' When 12 Then 'Released for Approve' When 13 Then 'Partially Approved' When 14 Then 'Discuss' When 15 Then 'Cancelled' When 16 Then 'Reversed' End As DocumentStatus
from SAL_GateIn
inner join set_DocumentType on set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_GateIn.DocumentTypeID and set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_GateIn.CompanyID and set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_GateIn.PeriodID

data.name: Query_SelectAll_Searching_ForApproveNew
data.value:
SELECT DISTINCT Gate_OutwardHeader.Gate_OutwardHeaderID, Gate_OutwardHeader.CompanyID, Gate_OutwardHeader.PeriodID, Gate_OutwardHeader.Status, Gate_OutwardHeader.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, Gate_OutwardHeader.DocumentNo, Gate_OutwardHeader.DocumentDate,
Gate_OutwardHeader.SupplierID, case when [Gate_OutwardHeader].SupplierID is null then [Gate_OutwardHeader].SupplierName else [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerName] end as VendorName, Gate_OutwardHeader.StatusCode, SET_DocumentApprove.ApprovalStatus, SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalOperator, SET_ApprovalAuthority.UserID AS UserID, SET_Authority.AuthorityLevel FROM Gate_OutwardHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = Gate_OutwardHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = Gate_OutwardHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Gate_OutwardHeader.DocumentTypeID INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = Gate_OutwardHeader.Gate_OutwardHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = Gate_OutwardHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = Gate_OutwardHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = AR_InvoiceDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = Gate_OutwardHeader.CompanyID Left JOIN AR_SET_Customer on Gate_OutwardHeader.SupplierID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND Gate_OutwardHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND Gate_OutwardHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentApprove ON SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = Gate_OutwardHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID = Gate_OutwardHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = Gate_OutwardHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = Gate_OutwardHeader.DocumentNo AND SET_DocumentApprove.CreateDate = (SELECT MAX(CreateDate) FROM SET_DocumentApprove WHERE CompanyID = Gate_OutwardHeader.CompanyID AND PeriodID = Gate_OutwardHeader.PeriodID AND DocumentTypeID = Gate_OutwardHeader.DocumentTypeID AND DocumentNo = Gate_OutwardHeader.DocumentNo) INNER JOIN SET_UserApprovalAmount ON SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID = Gate_OutwardHeader.CompanyID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID = Gate_OutwardHeader.PeriodID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.Status = 1 AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID = Gate_OutwardHeader.DocumentTypeID OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NULL AND (SELECT ih.TotalAmount FROM Gate_OutwardHeader ih WHERE ih.CompanyID = Gate_OutwardHeader.CompanyID AND ih.PeriodID = Gate_OutwardHeader.PeriodID AND ih.Gate_OutwardHeaderID = Gate_OutwardHeader.Gate_OutwardHeaderID) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT ih.TotalAmount FROM Gate_OutwardHeader ih WHERE ih.CompanyID = Gate_OutwardHeader.CompanyID AND ih.PeriodID = Gate_OutwardHeader.PeriodID AND ih.Gate_OutwardHeaderID = Gate_OutwardHeader.Gate_OutwardHeaderID) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) INNER JOIN SET_ApprovalAuthority ON SET_ApprovalAuthority.ApprovalAuthorityID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalAuthorityID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Authority ON SET_Authority.AuthorityID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.AuthorityID AND SET_Authority.CompanyID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID AND SET_Authority.PeriodID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID AND SET_Authority.Status = 1
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on Gate_OutwardHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID

data.name: Query_SelectAll_Searching_WithPaging_ForApproveNew
data.value:
SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY Gate_OutwardHeader.Gate_OutwardHeaderID) AS 'Row' FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT InvHeader_Outer.Gate_OutwardHeaderID, InvHeader_Outer.CompanyID, InvHeader_Outer.PeriodID, InvHeader_Outer.Status, InvHeader_Outer.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, InvHeader_Outer.DocumentNo, InvHeader_Outer.DocumentDate,
InvHeader_Outer.SupplierID, case when [InvHeader_Outer].SupplierID is null then [InvHeader_Outer].SupplierName else [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerName] end as VendorName, InvHeader_Outer.StatusCode, SET_DocumentApprove.ApprovalStatus, SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalOperator, SET_ApprovalAuthority.UserID AS UserID, SET_Authority.AuthorityLevel FROM Gate_OutwardHeader InvHeader_Outer INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = InvHeader_Outer.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = InvHeader_Outer.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = InvHeader_Outer.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType IN ('NON Returnable GON (GRN)', 'NON Returnable GON (GRN)_SITE', 'OpenReturnableGIN', 'OpenReturnableGIN_SITE', 'OpenReturnableGON', 'OpenReturnableGON_SITE') INNER JOIN Gate_OutwardDetail ON Gate_OutwardDetail.Gate_OutwardHeaderID = InvHeader_Outer.Gate_OutwardHeaderID AND Gate_OutwardDetail.CompanyID = InvHeader_Outer.CompanyID AND Gate_OutwardDetail.PeriodID = InvHeader_Outer.PeriodID INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = Gate_OutwardDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = Gate_OutwardDetail.CompanyID Left JOIN AR_SET_Customer on InvHeader_Outer.SupplierID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND InvHeader_Outer.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND InvHeader_Outer.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentApprove ON SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = InvHeader_Outer.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID = InvHeader_Outer.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = InvHeader_Outer.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = InvHeader_Outer.DocumentNo AND SET_DocumentApprove.CreateDate = (SELECT MAX(CreateDate) FROM SET_DocumentApprove WHERE CompanyID = InvHeader_Outer.CompanyID AND PeriodID = InvHeader_Outer.PeriodID AND DocumentTypeID = InvHeader_Outer.DocumentTypeID AND DocumentNo = InvHeader_Outer.DocumentNo) INNER JOIN SET_UserApprovalAmount ON SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID = InvHeader_Outer.CompanyID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID = InvHeader_Outer.PeriodID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.Status = 1 AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID = InvHeader_Outer.DocumentTypeID OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NULL AND (SELECT ih.TotalAmount FROM Gate_OutwardHeader ih WHERE ih.CompanyID = InvHeader_Outer.CompanyID AND ih.PeriodID = InvHeader_Outer.PeriodID AND ih.Gate_OutwardHeaderID = InvHeader_Outer.Gate_OutwardHeaderID) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT ih.TotalAmount FROM Gate_OutwardHeader ih WHERE ih.CompanyID = InvHeader_Outer.CompanyID AND ih.PeriodID = InvHeader_Outer.PeriodID AND ih.Gate_OutwardHeaderID = InvHeader_Outer.Gate_OutwardHeaderID) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) INNER JOIN SET_ApprovalAuthority ON SET_ApprovalAuthority.ApprovalAuthorityID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalAuthorityID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Authority ON SET_Authority.AuthorityID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.AuthorityID AND SET_Authority.CompanyID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID AND SET_Authority.PeriodID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID AND SET_Authority.Status = 1
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on InvHeader_Outer.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
) Gate_OutwardHeader

AS PartNo, IncRude_Item.Description as IncurredOn, Gate_outwardheader.Comments as Remarks, Gate_outwarddetail.ReferenceNo as Reference, case when set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Negative' then 'OUT' when set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Positive' then 'IN' when set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='No Impact' then '' else set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact end Status, SET_OperatingUnit.LogoImage ,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, Gate_outwardheader.ExpectedDate, --Fabrics_InventoryTokenHeader.DriverName '' as DriverName from Gate_outwardheader inner join set_DocumentType on set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Gate_outwardheader.DocumentTypeID and set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Gate_outwardheader.CompanyID and set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Gate_outwardheader.PeriodID inner join Gate_outwarddetail on Gate_outwarddetail.Gate_OutwardHeaderID = Gate_outwardheader.Gate_OutwardHeaderID and Gate_outwarddetail.companyID = Gate_outwardheader.companyID and Gate_outwarddetail.PeriodID = Gate_outwardheader.PeriodID inner join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = Gate_outwarddetail.itemID and INV_Item.companyID = Gate_outwardheader.companyID inner join set_location on set_location.locationID = Gate_outwardheader.locationID inner join AR_Set_customer on AR_Set_customer.CustomerID = Gate_outwardheader.SupplierID and AR_Set_customer.companyID = Gate_outwardheader.companyID and AR_Set_customer.PeriodID = Gate_outwardheader.PeriodID left join inv_StockTransactionDetail on inv_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = Gate_outwarddetail.SourceHeaderID and inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = Gate_outwarddetail.SourceLineID left join INV_Item IncRude_Item on IncRude_Item.ItemID = Gate_OutwardHeader.IncurredOnID and IncRude_Item.companyID = Gate_outwardheader.companyID Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = Gate_outwardheader.CompanyID Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Left JOIn SET_UnitofMeasure On SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = Gate_outwarddetail.TransactionUOMID --left Join Fabrics_InventoryTokenHeader on Fabrics_InventoryTokenHeader.TokenNo = Gate_outwardheader.TokenNo -- and Fabrics_InventoryTokenHeader.CustomerID = Gate_outwardheader.SupplierID -- and Fabrics_InventoryTokenHeader.CompanyID = Gate_outwardheader.CompanyID -- and Fabrics_InventoryTokenHeader.PeriodID = Gate_outwardheader.PeriodID -- and Fabrics_InventoryTokenHeader.Status = 1
where Gate_outwardheader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and Gate_outwardheader.PeriodID = @PeriodID {0}

data.name: Query_GetData_byKey_BarcodeNew
data.value: SELECT (CASE LEN([SAL_GateIn].GateInNo) WHEN 1 THEN '00000000000' + CAST([SAL_GateIn].GateInNo AS VARCHAR) WHEN 2 THEN '0000000000' + CAST([SAL_GateIn].GateInNo AS VARCHAR) WHEN 3 THEN '000000000' + CAST([SAL_GateIn].GateInNo AS VARCHAR) WHEN 4 THEN '00000000' + CAST([SAL_GateIn].GateInNo AS VARCHAR) WHEN 5 THEN '0000000' + CAST([SAL_GateIn].GateInNo AS VARCHAR) ELSE CAST([SAL_GateIn].GateInNo AS VARCHAR) END ) as Barcode, STUFF(( SELECT DISTINCT ', ' + DOH.DeliveryOrderNo FROM dbo.SAL_GateInDetail GID2 INNER JOIN dbo.SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader DOH ON DOH.CompanyID = GID2.CompanyID AND DOH.PeriodID = GID2.PeriodID AND DOH.DeliveryOrderID = GID2.DeliveryOrderID WHERE GID2.CompanyID = [SAL_GateIn].CompanyID AND GID2.PeriodID = [SAL_GateIn].PeriodID AND GID2.GateInID = [SAL_GateIn].GateInID FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 2, '') AS DeliveryOrders, * FROM [SAL_GateIn] WHERE [CompanyID] = @CompanyID and [GateInNo] = @GateInID and [PeriodID] = @PeriodID and [CurrentFiscalID] = @CurrentFiscalID and [DocumentTypeID] = @DocumentTypeID
